newsitem.title: JAPAN: H.I.S. to set up non-life insurance unit in autumn.
newsitem.headline: H.I.S. to set up non-life insurance unit in autumn.

text.p: Japanese discount ticket agency H.I.S. Co Ltd said on Tuesday it will set up a subsidiary this autumn in preparation for entering the non-life insurance business.
After its establishment, the firm will apply to the Ministry of Finance for permission to sell non-life policies, mainly travel insurance covering sickness, injury and liability.
Japanese insurance business laws stipulate that insurers have capital of at least one billion yen, an H.I.S. spokesman said.
He declined to give further details about the insurance unit.
The company announced on Monday that it would buy 76,000 new shares to be issued by another discount ticket agency, Map International Co Ltd, giving it a 19 percent stake in the company.
The purchase of the Map shares, valued at 39.14 million yen, is scheduled for September 1, H.I.S. said.
